data.title: WSJ reports OpenAI scrapped GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns
data.description: An X post shares an image claiming OpenAI canceled an October GPT-6.1 Astra release. OpenAI's public materials confirm GPT-6 Astra, not a scheduled 6.1.
